Subject: Exec sync to unblock pilot — availability?

Hi Jordan — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before looping in your execs:

- Current infra: 3-tier microservices on K8s (EKS), heavy inference latency spikes during peak batch windows (60–90s tail).
- Primary goal: 50–70% inference cost reduction while meeting 95th percentile latency < 300ms for the customer-facing inference path.
- Pilot scope we discussed: 2 model endpoints (chat + embedding), 2-week throughput soak with Redwood Dedicated in us-west.
- Success criteria: sustained 95th pct latency under 300ms and per-token cost < $0.002 for the pilot window.

Next step (to unblock procurement and internal approvals): a short executive alignment call so your CTO/VP can validate risk, SLOs, and billing model. Suggested ask: 30-minute sync with your CTO (or engineering lead) + our Head of Product/Eng.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 24: 9:30–10:00am or 3:00–3:30pm
- Wed Nov 25: 11:00–11:30am

I’ve attached a short pilot SOW + a tentative agenda. If those windows don’t work, send 2–3 that do and I’ll loop folks in.

Attachments: MADP_Pilot_SOW.pdf (high-level scope + KRs)

Thanks — Ben
